Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def transform(grid):
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); comps=components(grid,4)
    comps.sort(key=lambda z:(-len(z),min(r for r,c in z),min(c for r,c in z)))
    target,source=comps[:2]
    def adj7(comp):
      return {(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in comp for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C and grid[r+dr][c+dc]==7}
    t7=adj7(target)
    # Place the source component at the target marker: its cell nearest the source
    # marker maps to the first target-marker cell.
    s7=adj7(source); tr,tc=min(t7)
    sr,sc=min(source,key=lambda rc:min(abs(rc[0]-r)+abs(rc[1]-c) for r,c in s7))
    dr,dc=tr-sr,tc-sc
    r0=min(r for r,c in target);r1=max(r for r,c in target);c0=min(c for r,c in target);c1=max(c for r,c in target)
    out=[[1]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
    for r,c in target:out[r-r0][c-c0]=4
    for r,c in source:
      rr,cc=r+dr-r0,c+dc-c0
      if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]):out[rr][cc]=4
    for r,c in t7:
      rr,cc=r-r0,c-c0
      if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]):out[rr][cc]=4
    return out

def transform(grid):
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); comps=components(grid,4)
    comps.sort(key=lambda z:(-len(z),min(r for r,c in z),min(c for r,c in z)))
    target=comps[0]
    source=[(r,c) for comp in comps[1:] for r,c in comp]
    def adj7(comp):
      return {(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in comp for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C and grid[r+dr][c+dc]==7}
    t7=adj7(target);s7={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]==7}-t7
    tr,tc=min(t7);sr,sc=min(source,key=lambda rc:min(abs(rc[0]-r)+abs(rc[1]-c) for r,c in s7));dr,dc=tr-sr,tc-sc
    moved=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in source]
    anchor=target+list(t7)+moved
    r0=min(r for r,c in anchor);r1=max(r for r,c in anchor);c0=min(c for r,c in anchor);c1=max(c for r,c in anchor)
    out=[[1]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
    for r,c in target+moved+list(t7):
      out[r-r0][c-c0]=4
    return out
